Content:
A unit rate is a comparison of two quantities where one of the terms has a quantity of [MATH: 1.] This means the ratio, in fraction form, has a denominator of [MATH: 1.]

Content:
For instance, suppose Michael earned [MATH: \[math] 200] by selling [MATH: 4] identical tires.

Content:
The ratio of dollars to tires is [MATH: {\color{blue}200}:{\color{red}4}.] Writing the ratio as a fraction, we have
[MATH: \dfrac{{\color{blue}200}}{{\color{red}4}} \, .]

Content:
The unit rate is how many dollars Michael got for [MATH: 1] tire.

Content:
We can make a denominator of [MATH: 1] by dividing the numerator and denominator by [MATH: 4\mathbin{:}]
[MATH: \dfrac{{\color{blue}200} \div 4}{{\color{red}4} \div 4} = \dfrac{{\color{blue}50}}{{\color{red}1}}]

Content:
This is the unit rate. In this case, we say that Michael got [MATH: \color{blue}50] dollars per tire.

Item 1 — Tutorial: Introduction

Content:
A unit rate is a comparison of two quantities where one of the terms has a quantity of [MATH: 1.] This means the ratio, in fraction form, has a denominator of [MATH: 1.]

Content:
For instance, suppose Michael earned [MATH: \[math] 200] by selling [MATH: 4] identical tires.

Content:
The ratio of dollars to tires is [MATH: {\color{blue}200}:{\color{red}4}.] Writing the ratio as a fraction, we have
[MATH: \dfrac{{\color{blue}200}}{{\color{red}4}} \, .]

Content:
The unit rate is how many dollars Michael got for [MATH: 1] tire.

Content:
We can make a denominator of [MATH: 1] by dividing the numerator and denominator by [MATH: 4\mathbin{:}]
[MATH: \dfrac{{\color{blue}200} \div 4}{{\color{red}4} \div 4} = \dfrac{{\color{blue}50}}{{\color{red}1}}]

Content:
This is the unit rate. In this case, we say that Michael got [MATH: \color{blue}50] dollars per tire.

---

We can make a denominator of [MATH: 1] by dividing the numerator and denominator by [MATH: 2\mathbin{:}]
[MATH: \dfrac{16 \div 2}{2 \div 2} = \dfrac{8}{1} = 8]

So,

[MATH: \qquad] [MATH: 16] chickens in [MATH: 2] chicken coops [MATH: = 8] chickens per chicken coop.
